ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous high-intensity white blob occupying the lateral-medial region of the left lobe; fragmented white mottling concentrated on the distal tip of the right lobe; central peduncle and medial fluke regions are solid low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a narrow vertex angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge featuring high-frequency micro-serrations and several larger jagged indentations, most prominent on the right lobe's inner margin.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex sweep along the outer margins leading to narrow, tapered tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Sparse circular low-intensity pixel clusters localized within the white pigment zone of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of high-contrast white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) traversing the central black pigmentation and intersecting white boundaries.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged tissue loss/notching on the trailing edge of the right lobe and dense, multi-directional linear rake marks across the central fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density convergence of linear abrasions at the junction of the fluke and peduncle.
